correction.textOverride: Someone watching soccer for the first time might be surprise by what happens when the final whistle blows. After an intense contest, the players takes off their jerseys and swap them with members of the opposing team. The spirit of fair play are still important. Also, if an opponent gets injured, the ball is kicked out of play so that he or she receive medical treatment.
